title: Crew Declaration
description: Optional `crew_declaration` an SDK sends in session-create metadata beside agent_key (CREW-18/20). Both keys are CONTENT: the backend extracts and removes this object from metadata before any generic persistence or telemetry, so the keys live only in crew tables. Content-less mode sends nothing (the session stays unbound). Wire location: `metadata.crew_declaration` of POST /api/v1/sessions. Deliberately NOT referenced from the optimization documents: that channel is content-class linted and closed (the ratchet admits no new legacy_content), and `metadata` is already a free object, so this crew-domain schema is the authority for the optional key.

role_key.description: Stable role key inside the crew. CONTENT.
